name: MiMi
source:
Main character is treated at a villa after an accident resulting in memory loss. A bride and a maid come to help him regain memory and make his mysterious promise fulfilled. He gradually gets attracted to the girls. What's hidden in the lost memories? What's protagonist's true identity? Who does he really love?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公因事故失去记忆，正在一栋别墅内疗养。一名新娘和一名女仆前来帮助他恢复记忆，并履行那份神秘的约定。他逐渐被二人吸引。失去的记忆中隐藏着什么？主人公的真实身份是什么？他真正爱着谁？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
